info.title: inhuman-harness daemon RPC
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket text frames on `<root>/daemon.sock`. Generated from @inhuman.tools/harness-contract.

methods.name: kv/set
methods.summary: Write a key in session, project or kernel scope
methods.description: Session `model` / `connection` also become the last-choice default (project + kernel) when `remember` is set. `/model` and `/connect` send "1"; a bare session write (subagent, `--model`, `--connection`) does not.

methods.name: kv/clear
methods.summary: Clear a key in session, project or kernel scope

methods.name: plugin/method
methods.summary: Call a plugin's own state method
methods.description: A plugin command's call into that plugin's own state. `args` is a JSON object, since action params cross as strings. `field` names the argument the composer text (`input`) fills; an empty `input` then refuses. A failure is data (`ok: false`), not an RPC error.

methods.name: policy/set
methods.summary: Set the session's permission mode

methods.name: policy/explain
methods.summary: Explain what would happen to a call right now
methods.description: Runs the same floor, grant and resolution code as a real call, with no judge and no effect. Returns the tier (block, soft-deny, ask, allow), the classes that voted, which resolver licenses it in the session's mode and from which layer, and the outcome.

methods.name: policy/overlay
methods.summary: Set or clear this session's authorization overlay
methods.description: A human decision for this session only. It may loosen what the user's config says, but never past the project layer. Refused for any caller that is not a human client.

methods.name: policy/config-get
methods.summary: Read the authorization layers this session resolves against

methods.name: connect/adopt
methods.summary: Adopt a connection and make it this session's connection
methods.description: Delegates to the kernel's `connect/adopt`, then writes the new connection id into the session's `connection` key and warms it. May park for UI.

methods.name: turn
methods.summary: Submit a prompt as a turn, a steer or a queued prompt
methods.description: Pictures (`visuals`) ride only on a fresh turn: standard base64, stored beside the session, and the model must accept images.

methods.name: turn/cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a running turn by turn id or eval request id

methods.name: turn/visual
methods.summary: Read one picture seated on the session's head turn

methods.name: turn/rewind
methods.summary: Rewind the session to before a turn

methods.name: turn/retry
methods.summary: Retry the last turn

methods.name: blob/get
methods.summary: Read one blob the session's document references, by content hash
methods.description: Large bodies (a file's prior text today) live in the kernel's blob bucket; the document keeps `{sha256, bytes, mime, head}`. `text/*` blobs return `text`, anything else `bytesBase64`. The hash a document names is the capability; there is no listing.

methods.name: blob/vacuum
methods.summary: Move the session's large stored text into the blob bucket
methods.description: A session written before large bodies left the document keeps a file's prior text and an isolated completion's prompt inline, and the stored image carries them forever. The vacuum moves every such body over the inline limit into the kernel's blob bucket, leaving the head and a reference, then rewrites the stored image as one snapshot. Completions still running are skipped. `dryRun` counts what would move and writes nothing. Reads stay whole: the wire projection and `blob/get` resolve the references.

methods.name: compact
methods.summary: Compact the session's context, optionally around a focus

methods.name: rename
methods.summary: Set the session title

methods.name: eval
methods.summary: Admit a Scheme program as an unattended eval turn
methods.description: Idempotent per `requestId`: a repeat with the same input returns the admitted turn; a repeat with different input is refused. `ok: false` with `policy_unavailable` means the requested permission policy cannot run unattended.

methods.name: ask/answer
methods.summary: Answer the live approval ask
methods.description: Answer the live ask or soft-deny on `sessionId`: this session, or a worker that escalated to it. `store` remembers a human yes to an ask as a grant (scope, subject, TTL); a soft-deny is never stored and a block is never put to a human.

methods.name: ack/pending
methods.summary: List calls waiting for an acknowledgement
methods.description: A call that is allowed but flagged `needsAcknowledgement` waits for a person. Acks travel over RPC only: there is no ack job and no transcript entry. Absent `sessionId`: this session and the workers that escalated to it.

methods.name: ack/answer
methods.summary: Acknowledge or refuse a pending call, optionally remembering the acknowledgement
methods.description: Human clients only. `accept` lets the call run; a refusal is a human denial (its `comment` is what the agent reads). `store` remembers the acknowledgement at session, project, bot or global scope as one of the offered `storeOptions`; prompt-created project, bot and global acks last 7 days. A block and a policy denial are never put here. When the prompt was also an ask (a combined prompt), the same answer settles both.

methods.name: resident/set
methods.summary: Mark the session resident (kept alive) or not

methods.name: queue/steer-first
methods.summary: Promote the first queued prompt to a steer
methods.description: A queued row named by the id the client saw. Already drained or moved is `ok: false`.

methods.name: queue/retract-last
methods.summary: Retract the last queued prompt
methods.description: A queued row named by the id the client saw. Already drained or moved is `ok: false`.

methods.name: agent-calls/list
methods.summary: List agent calls made from this session

methods.name: agent-calls/inspect
methods.summary: Inspect one agent call by request id

methods.name: agent-calls/cancel
methods.summary: Cancel one agent call by request id

methods.name: term-continue/set
methods.summary: Remember which session a terminal key continues

methods.name: term-continue/clear
methods.summary: Forget a terminal key's continue session

methods.name: connect/drop
methods.summary: Remove a connection and its secrets
methods.description: Without `confirm: true` it parks on a confirmation form; cancelling answers `{ok: false}`.

methods.name: connect/adopt
methods.summary: Adopt a connection from a driver
methods.description: Runs the driver's adopt flow. The flow may need the human (sign-in, a pasted key) and then parks. Cancelling answers `{ok: false}`.

methods.name: connect/list
methods.summary: List connections, optionally by ability claim

methods.name: connect/models
methods.summary: Probe the model catalog of one or all connections

methods.name: connect/get
methods.summary: Read one connection with its settings

methods.name: connect/set-enabled
methods.summary: Enable or disable a connection

methods.name: connect/always-allow
methods.summary: Always allow one tool of a connection

methods.name: connect/exclude-tool
methods.summary: Exclude one tool of a connection

methods.name: connect/login
methods.summary: Sign in to a connection
methods.description: May open a browser flow and park until the human finishes it.

methods.name: connect/logout
methods.summary: Sign out of a connection

methods.name: connect/update
methods.summary: Rename a connection or merge its settings
methods.description: Rename or merge settings of a connection that already exists. The id stays.

methods.name: mcp-server/adopt
methods.summary: Adopt an MCP server as a connection
methods.description: May need the human (sign-in) and then parks.

methods.name: mcp-server/search
methods.summary: Search the official MCP registry

methods.name: config/set
methods.summary: Set kernel configuration fields

methods.name: grant/list
methods.summary: List stored grants

methods.name: grant/add
methods.summary: Store a grant from settings
methods.description: A grant turns an ask into allow for a family (a command, a path, an MCP server+tool+account). It never lifts a soft-deny or a block. Settings grants do not expire unless `ttlMs` is given.

methods.name: grant/revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a stored grant

methods.name: ack/list
methods.summary: List stored acknowledgements
methods.description: The acknowledgements a person stored at session, project, bot or global scope (same rows, TTL and scopes as grants). Flags themselves live in the `authorization` block (see `policy/config-get`).

methods.name: ack/add
methods.summary: Store an acknowledgement from settings
methods.description: Equivalent to "you can send any email you want in this project". Settings acknowledgements do not expire unless `ttlMs` is given.

methods.name: ack/revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a stored acknowledgement

methods.name: plugin/set
methods.summary: Enable, disable or foreground a plugin

methods.name: plugin/install
methods.summary: Install a plugin from an npm spec

methods.name: plugin/remove
methods.summary: Remove an installed plugin

methods.name: skill/list
methods.summary: List skill files for a project and home

methods.name: skill/write
methods.summary: Write a skill file

methods.name: skill/remove
methods.summary: Remove a skill file

methods.name: skill/read
methods.summary: Read a skill file with its body

methods.name: bot/write
methods.summary: Write a bot definition
methods.description: Absent `invokes`, `reasoningEffort` and `modelPreferences` keep the file's current value; an empty list clears. Absent `mcp` keeps the file's grants; an empty list clears them. A settings save that does not know these fields must not wipe them.

methods.name: bot/remove
methods.summary: Remove a bot definition

methods.name: ui/resolve
methods.summary: Answer a parked UI form
methods.description: Finishes a call that answered `{form: "ui", pending, body}`. The reply is the resumed call's result, or another park form. `kind: "cancel"` aborts the parked call. Closing the socket cancels every park it owns.
